'''John Turcovic''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2002 Livingston tournament]] on 27 April 2002 with Watto deck, according to Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3615">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowdd3615/ livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowd], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 29 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-livinston-nj-4-27-02-another-big-crowdd3615/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
